name: text-ribbon
title: Text ribbon
author: Sanjay Kumar <https://github.com/luv-jeri>
description: A measured phrase follows six original SVG paths, with direct manipulation and gentle changes of pace.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Horizontal drag, arrow keys and Home directly position the ribbon.

props.name: auto
props.description: Automatic movement is opt-in. Pair it with a visible pause control.

props.name: speed
props.description: SVG units per second, bounded to 0–120.

props.name: direction
props.description: Supply direction/onDirectionChange to control direction after dragging.

props.name: curvature
props.description: Wave and arch curvature, from a straight path (0) to the full curve (1).

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Size in the 640 × 280 SVG, bounded to 24–56. The entire ribbon scales responsively.
